what: One real run of the opt-in LLM verifier (DEP_GRAPH_LLM=verify) on the GitHub catalog, then a blind check of its decisions: every edge it dropped plus a random sample (seed 5) of the doubtful edges it kept, judged by a neutral and a skeptical judge that saw no scores and not which group an edge was in (eval/audit_verifier.ts).
caveats: Judges share a model family with the author. 52 edges; the kept sample is 30 of 114. Judge labels are opinions about API semantics. Whether a GraphQL node id counts as a valid supply for an id input is a judgment call, and most of the wrongful drops are of that kind.
